lines.zh: 我一步一步走过来，地面被踩出响。
lines.en: I come step by step, and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 我的披风拖在身后，很长。
lines.en: My cloak drags long behind me.

lines.zh: 我不急着走快，我不需要。
lines.en: I do not hasten; I have no need.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走进更深的地方。
lines.en: I walk from shadow into deeper shadow.
My horns scrape the door frame.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把挡路的枝条烧断。
lines.en: I raise a hand and burn the branch aside.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片地走，先看一遍。
lines.en: I circle the ground to see it first.
My steps are heavy as a drum.
I walk your way without stopping.
I stand with flame burning on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我很安静，安静比吼更吓人。
lines.en: I am quiet; quiet frightens more than roaring.

lines.zh: 我脚下的裂纹又深了一寸。
lines.en: The cracks beneath me deepen another inch.

lines.zh: 我在听，谁的胆子这么大。
lines.en: I am listening; who has such nerve?
I turn my wrist slowly.
The stone by my feet begins to blacken.
I am waiting for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 我的披风边角在烧，自己会合上。
lines.en: The edge of my cloak burns and closes again.
I am weighing whether it is worth my hand.
I lift my eyes to the sky.
My horns catch the red light.
I stand as steady as a tower.
The ground under me is cracked.
I lower my eyelids to you.
You stand before me and have not run.
You are bolder than I expected.
I slant my head aside.
You wear no armor.
Speak; I am listening.
My shadow passes over your head.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你身后，那扇门。
lines.en: My gaze settles on the door behind you.
That you are here is reason enough.
I watch you a while longer.
Your knuckles whiten around the sword.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，手在发抖。
lines.en: Your hands shake while you look at me.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，火暗了一下。
lines.en: I give half a step and the fire dims.

lines.zh: 肩甲凹了一块，我转了转脖子。
lines.en: A dent in my pauldron; I roll my neck.
I raise a hand to the wound.
Blood falls and the ground chars.
I raise my head, my eyes brighter.
Well, that is somewhat interesting.

lines.zh: 这一击擦过我的角，火星四溅。
lines.en: The blow grazes my horn, scattering sparks.
Your hand is heavier than I expected.
Now I will truly act.
You offer that to me.

lines.zh: 你的供品连我的脚背都盖不住。
lines.en: Your offering doesn't even cover my foot.

lines.zh: 这点东西，连我的脚边都到不了。
lines.en: That does not even reach my feet.
I turn my face to one side.

lines.zh: 魔王要的不是这点东西。
lines.en: The demon king wants more than this.

lines.zh: 你把它举得再高也没用。
lines.en: Raising it higher will not help.
My appetite lies elsewhere.
You hold this one.
It does not even carry a scent.

lines.zh: 我抬手一推，你就滑开了。
lines.en: I push once and you slide away.
My cloak sweeps across you.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，你的手会记得。
lines.en: Touch me and your hand will remember.
I did not even raise my eyes.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，退得很快。
lines.en: You pull back quickly.
I exist only in a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 你撞在我膝上，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: You hit my knee like a wall.
My throne is just behind me.
I stopped speaking of such things long ago.
You ask too casually.
I have no interest in that.
I turn my back to you.

lines.zh: 这种东西，我丢了很多年。
lines.en: I cast that away many years ago.
One corner of my mouth moved.
That is not among a king's concerns.
I lift a foot and walk away.
You may withdraw.
I do not care to hear this.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，看了眼就捏碎。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and crush it.
I will accept this one.
Light as a flake of ash.
I set it on the stone.
It turns to ash in my hand.
Is this your show of respect?
I will not take this one.
I did not even lower my head.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼里的火亮了。
lines.en: I raise my head and the fire in my eyes kindles.
You have finally stirred.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的那一瞬，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the instant you lift your foot.
The shadow at my feet stretches.

lines.zh: 我的刷怪蛋有，记录没有。
lines.en: I have a spawn egg but no records.
The light in this place dims.
The waiting ends here.
You have backed to the edge.
Of them all, I have chosen you.
This will not take long.
I throw my cloak back.
Fire rises from my fist.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经贴在地上了。
lines.en: Your shadow is already pinned to the ground.
Come before me.
I lower my head.
I strike first this time.
You had better plant your feet.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，一步一步。
lines.en: I walk at you, step by step.

lines.zh: 你往哪儿躲，我都在后面。
lines.en: Wherever you hide, I am behind.
I am not fast; you cannot escape.
I raise a finger and point.
Fire pours from my palm.
The ground here is heating.
My shadow follows you without pause.

lines.zh: 你在找退路，我看得出来。
lines.en: You are looking for a way out; I can tell.
I have closed your path.
I have no need to hurry my pace.
This road ends at an end.
You glanced back again.
I am in no hurry; I do not tire.
The fire has cracked the ground.
Three more steps and you are there.
You have no room left.
This time I will act.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地上裂开。
lines.en: I bring my fist down and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 我的掌推出去，火跟着走。
lines.en: My palm goes out, and fire follows.
My claw rakes across your chest.
I kick you away.

lines.zh: 火从我的指缝里喷出来。
lines.en: Fire sprays between my fingers.
I clamp your shoulder and press down.
You were burned; I can smell it.
That was light; it was a reminder.
My horn meets your chest.
I did not stop once.
You have not fallen; that is interesting.
The last blow, I will not spare.

lines.zh: 阴影先聚拢，然后我才成形。
lines.en: The shadows gather first; then I take shape.
Flame rises out of the earth.
The air has suddenly grown heavy.

lines.zh: 我从裂开的地面走上来。
lines.en: I climb out of the split ground.

lines.zh: 我的披风先出现，然后是我的头。
lines.en: My cloak appears first, then my head.
The light in this place has withdrawn.
I raise my horns.

lines.zh: 地上的石头一片片黑下去。
lines.en: The stones darken one by one.

lines.zh: 我落下的时候，没有声音。
lines.en: When I land, there is no sound.
I look once around at all of you.
Cracks begin at my feet.
The wind has stopped here.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方来，脚步很沉。
lines.en: I came from far away, heavy-footed.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，只是一个手势。
lines.en: I raise a hand, nothing more.
You should have run sooner.
The ash on the ground lifts.

lines.zh: 王座上的灰先落下来，然后是我。
lines.en: Ash falls from the throne first, then I arrive.
I speak, and my voice is low.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，可它还是烫。
lines.en: Fire does not harm me, yet it still burns.

lines.zh: 落地时整片石面都塌了。
lines.en: The whole stone floor gave way when I landed.

lines.zh: 水扑上来，我把它烧开了一半。
lines.en: Water rushes in; I boil half of it off.
The blast throws my cloak back.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的肩，我拔了出来。
lines.en: Something lodges in my shoulder; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 一股力缠了我一下，我甩开了。
lines.en: Some force binds me; I shake it off.
Even this body empties.
Lightning strikes my horn, and I laugh.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一时找不到落处。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I find no landing.
